scientific_intent.domain: Classical molecular dynamics of a water/octane configuration
scientific_intent.scientific_question: Advance a molecular configuration under Lennard–Jones and periodic Ewald forces with the source NVT Nose–Hoover thermostat and rigid-body rotations.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: Eleven all-pairs LJ + real/reciprocal Ewald force evaluations (kmax3), complete original CPU integration, rotation, thermostat, potential, observables and file-I/O pipeline.
scientific_intent.classification_rationale: Particle/molecular simulation with pair potentials and reciprocal periodic charge interactions; the selected input uses MD, not Monte Carlo.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Molecular simulation developers comparing force accuracy and a complete CPU/GPU integration path. No equilibrium chemical accuracy or infinite-Ewald convergence claim.
scientific_intent.support_boundary: Original input: 3,379 ATOM records minus eight BOX markers = 3,371 physical atoms, 955 molecules, 10 fs with dt1 fs, pform1 LJES, kmax3, orthogonal 50 Å cell. Other potential modes/MC/SP/optimization are not certified. Original CPU integrator is shared, not independently rewritten.
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: All returned GPU atom buffers and actual device inputs for every force call; initial47,220-value raw Float64 prefix is bit-exact. All2,517,798 artifact fields per trial compare at absolute2e-6 + relative2e-10. Independent long-double force checks cover every coordinate at all11 steps; additional finite/rigid-distance/total-force checks. Listed host vectors and four statistics are captured; not all CLI bytes or unlisted host statistics.
scientific_intent.scientific_task: Full original 10 fs molecular-dynamics trajectory for 3,371 physical atoms and 955 movable molecules.

A raw14-Float64 atom view preserves the112-byte C POD and packed Int32 IDs. Source anchor POD copy becomes indexed field reads in Julia; actual load hoisting/register placement was not profiled.

keyconfounds: Single source input and short10 fs trajectory, not equilibrium validation.
Full original CPU controller remains common; no independent full integrator rewrite.
Only selected pform1 branch is authored/certified; polarization is unverified, not framework unsupported.
Source allocation/copy members retained but adapter groups independent allocations before copies.
Native NVCC and Julia compiler stacks differ; no measured causal attribution of the slowdown.
CUDA.jl retained trial3=15.582581117 s; no outlier was dropped.
Source printed offload subtimes contain the added CPU oracle; only structured corrected ROI is comparative.
